name: To Fool a Fool
source:
From your normal everyday life you are summoned, or rather, ripped away to a land of magic and monsters. Labeled a hero, you are tasked by an arrogant king to slay the dragon and save his kingdom. 

However with no magic, no knightly training, you have to rely on the mysterious and magic wielding court jester to help you survive this so-called ‘noble quest’. 

Yet with a prince looking to also use you for his own political and selfish ends, can you really trust that you will get your fairy tale ending?
